tools.name: Search
tools.description: Browse or search the public YC company directory. Query is optional: omit it to list every company matching the exact source labels for batch (e.g. Summer 2025), industry, region, status and tag, or the hiring, top company and nonprofit flags. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.

options.name: nonprofit

options.name: page

response.about: Browse or search the public YC company directory. tools.name: Search models
tools.description: Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

options.name: creator
options.about: Creator name filter, case-insensitive substring (e.g. `anthropic`, `openai`).

options.name: cursor
options.about: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

options.name: include_deprecated
options.about: Include models the site marks deprecated (most of the table: 420 of 684 rows on 2026-09-29). Implied true when `slug` is given.

options.name: limit
options.about: Results per page (1-100).

options.name: open_weights
options.about: Only open-weights (true) or proprietary (false) models.

options.name: query
options.about: Case-insensitive terms matched against model name, short name, slug and creator; every whitespace-separated term must match (substring: `deepseek-v3` also matches `deepseek-v3-0324`; use `slug` for an exact row). Punctuation is folded on both sides, so `Claude Sonnet 5.5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5` and `claude-sonnet-5-5` find the same rows. One model per call: a list of several names matches nothing.

options.name: reasoning
options.about: Only reasoning (true) or non-reasoning (false) models.

options.name: slug
options.about: Exact model slug at one reasoning effort (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`, `deepseek-v3`) or a pasted https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/{slug} URL: returns that one row (effort siblings such as `-high`/`-low` are not matched). Implies `include_deprecated: true` so legacy slugs resolve; the row's `deprecated` says whether the site still lists it. Combines with the other filters. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+$.

response.about: Search the Artificial Analysis LLM leaderboard: every model and reasoning-effort variant (current and deprecated) with its Intelligence Index, Intelligence Index cost per task (USD, null when unmeasured), benchmark scores, list prices (USD per 1M tokens: the model's list price as the leaderboard states it, not scoped to an API provider; provider-scoped input, output and cache rates are in list_model_providers and search_provider_endpoints), output speed and latency percentiles, sorted by Intelligence Index; reports the index version the page states. Looks up one row by exact `slug`, or filters by text, creator, reasoning and open-weights status; client-side pages over the whole table.

fields.name: benchmarks
fields.about: Benchmark scores as the site reports them (raw values, not percentages). A key is present only when that surface reports the evaluation; null means the site has not measured it for this model.

fields.name: creator_name
fields.about: Model creator as labelled by the site (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI).

fields.name: intelligence_index
fields.about: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0..100); null when not evaluated.

fields.name: intelligence_index_cost_per_task_usd
fields.about: USD to run one Intelligence Index task, weighted across the index's evaluations at the model's list prices (the leaderboard's Cost per Task column); null when the site has not measured it (unevaluated or estimated index).

fields.name: intelligence_index_is_estimated
fields.about: True when the site estimates the index from a subset of evaluations.

fields.name: performance
fields.about: Leaderboard performance columns measured by Artificial Analysis; null when the site lists the endpoint (pricing, features) but has not benchmarked it yet.

fields.name: price_class
fields.about: Site price class (low, medium, high, ...).

tools.name: Get model
tools.description: When you have a model slug from search_models (or a pasted /models/{slug} URL) and need the full benchmark record.

options.name: slug
options.about: Model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1`, `gpt-6-luna-high`) or a pasted https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/{slug} URL. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+$.

response.about: One model record at one reasoning effort from its artificialanalysis.ai page: identity (uuid, slug, release, effort, creator), Intelligence Index with its component evaluations, cost and time per task, benchmark scores, capability indices, list prices, and the first-party provider's output speed, time to first token and end-to-end (500-token) response time with percentiles and per-prompt-type medians.

fields.name: benchmarks
fields.about: Benchmark scores as the site reports them (raw values, not percentages). A key is present only when that surface reports the evaluation; null means the site has not measured it for this model.

fields.name: cache_hit_discount_percent
fields.about: Cache read discount as a fraction of the input price.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.about: Site capability indices keyed by domain in snake_case (finance_and_accounting, strategy_and_ops, legal, healthcare_and_medical, engineering, economics); empty when not evaluated.

fields.name: deprecated_to
fields.about: Slug of the successor when deprecated.

fields.name: effort
fields.about: Reasoning effort of this variant; null when the model has none.

fields.name: host_model_count
fields.about: Number of API endpoints the site benchmarks for this model.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Site uuid of the model/effort record; stable when slugs are renamed.

fields.name: intelligence_index
fields.about: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0..100).

fields.name: intelligence_index_cost_per_task_usd
fields.about: USD cost broken down by token class; null when the site has not run the Intelligence Index on this endpoint.

fields.name: intelligence_index_evaluations
fields.about: Component evaluations of the Intelligence Index with per-task cost and time.

fields.name: intelligence_index_run_cost_usd
fields.about: USD cost broken down by token class; null when the site has not run the Intelligence Index on this endpoint.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix milliseconds when this program read the page.

fields.name: pricing_usd_per_1m_tokens
fields.about: List prices in USD per 1M tokens as published by the provider and recorded by the site. Blended prices are present only where the site publishes them (model records and per-model provider endpoints).

fields.name: requested_slug
fields.about: The slug as given, normalized.
